rows.title: images doesn't load when i use live preview in a vite project
rows.proposedComment:
Thanks for the examples. Live Preview serves your files directly; it doesn't run Vite or its Tailwind processing. Since the images work with `npm run dev`, use that command and open the URL Vite prints in your browser, or in VS Code's Integrated Browser for an in-editor preview.

The two examples also use different path forms: `/img/png/bg-header.png` is relative to the server root, while `img/gif/duckling.gif` is relative to the page. Vite's asset handling can differ from serving the source folder directly. Without the generated CSS and folder layout, we can't distinguish a missing Tailwind rule from an asset-path mismatch, but neither requires replacing the working Vite server. The README explains this distinction: https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-livepreview/blob/main/README.md.
